description_for_human: Book private luxury houseboats in Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala. 1, 2 & 3 bedroom AC houseboats with all meals and backwater cruise included.
description_for_model: Kalappura Houseboats offers private houseboat stays in Alleppey, Kerala, India. Provides 1 bedroom (couples, up to 3 guests), 2 bedroom (small families, up to 6 guests), and 3 bedroom (groups, up to 9 guests) houseboats. All bookings include overnight stay, all meals, AC bedrooms, onboard crew, and backwater cruise through Vembanad Lake. Prices start at INR 15,000 per room per night for Standard package. Check-in 12 PM, check-out 9 AM next day.
